exposure: Polymorphisms in VEGFA, PTGS2, NOS3, TNF, and NOS2 genes
ZIKV infection in the first trimester
cohort: The study evaluated forty children with Congenital Zika Syndrome (CZS) and forty-eight children who were in utero exposed to ZIKV infection but born without congenital anomalies.
finding: The study found a higher risk of CZS due to the NOS2 rs2297518[A] allele, and observed that the T allele, TT/CT genotypes of TNF rs1799724, and haplotypes associated with higher TNF expression were more prevalent in children with CZS and severe microcephaly, alongside a higher risk of CZS with ZIKV infection in the first trimester.
